patch_description: Add a single lightweight RX "refresh" gate on the hub qubit (wire 0) right after the CRZ entangling block and before the final RZ output layer. Qubit 0 acts as the central hub with the most connections (4 CRZ gates), so its state has accumulated the most entanglement-induced phase. Injecting a fresh RX rotation there (a different axis than the RZ before/after) mixes amplitude components at the most information-dense node, potentially improving expressivity and gradient flow with minimal cost (+1 param, +1 gate, +1 depth). This is a cheap, targeted change consistent with prior parameter-efficiency goals.
